title: Managed Database: outage exclusions
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database outage exclusions is specified by contracted tier. Incident cause codes excluded from service credits; string list.

| Contracted tier | Outage exclusions |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream customer |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream customer |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream customer |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream customer |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream customer |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream customer |
